info.title: Cadasto SMART on openEHR (Reference)
info.description:
This file provides a lightweight reference for SMART on openEHR within Cadasto.
It intentionally does not replicate the full specification. Instead, it points
to the official SMART on openEHR documentation, which defines the canonical
behaviors, flows, and endpoints.

Use this as a discovery pointer in documentation bundles or tooling that expects
an OpenAPI document. For full details, refer to:
https://specifications.openehr.org/releases/ITS-REST/development/smart_app_launch.html
